newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firm as funds sought for T-bills, year-end.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firm as funds sought for T-bills, year-end.

text.p: The rouble was little changed on Wednesday but dealers said its credit rates were relatively high as banks and clients sought to close year-end positions, while the government bond market was also sweeping up funds.
roubles/dollar Dec 18 midday Dec 18 early Dec 17 close
"Roubles have been fairly expensive these last three days as banks and their clients need to make various payments before the year ends," one dealer said.
Dealers said funds were also shifted for today's auctions of government securities and could return to the rouble/dollar market only on Thursday.
Today the central bank is auctioning eight trillion roubles of six-month T-bills and two trillion roubles of OFZ bonds.
